note: Family-run campground on former farmland 10 km east of Bashaw on Hwy 53, then 1.5 km north, open since 1988. Mostly seasonal (over 150 seasonal sites, all taken, with a waiting list) plus 20+ weekender sites spread through the campground. Recreation room, playgrounds, basketball, pickleball and horseshoes, weekend events; 5-minute drive to Buffalo Lake. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: 2026 rates 'TBA'; the 2024 rate (C$44 fully serviced + GST) found on the archived reservations page; booking by request form, 3-night long-weekend minimum, one-night deposit; season May long weekend - Thanksgiving confirmed; full hookups, showers, flush toilets, laundry, store. Long-stay tests: test 2 weak (no current posted rate), test 4 passes narrowly (20+ of ~170). Google 4.7/87.
flags: LONG STAY / PRICE - reviewer's call: the operator says 'Willow Grove Family Campground is primarily a 'seasonal' campground, with over 150 sites designated for seasonal ... all seasonal sites are occupied, and there is a small waiting list' and 'we have 20+ weekender sites ... ideal for family and friends of our seasonal campers'. Test 4: 20+ of ~170+ sites (~12%) sold short-term - passes narrowly. Test 1: nights are for sale by request form with no application (the waitlist is for seasonal sites only) - pass. Test 2 (posted nightly rate): the live page reads 'Camping rates for 2026: Fully serviced sites - $TBA/night + GST' - NO current posted rate; the last posted rate is 2024's C$44 + GST (archived 2025-05-15). Test 3 (no standing minimum over 2 nights): only long weekends need 3 nights - pass. Test 5: not a home community - pass. Under the long-stay standard the missing 2026 rate is a drop reason unless the 2024 rate is accepted; RV Life $$$ cannot stand in.
PRICE GATE: 2024 fully serviced C$44 + GST - passes C$69. No engine (request form only), so no quote possible. The 'Overflow (unserviced) sites - $25' are an overflow lot, not the base.
